""Cervie77"":

I wish someone would start writing some fan-fics about the multiverse…

Well It’s not quite fan fics, but my brain goes on kicks where it tries to assign most of the music I hear to some fandom or another of mine. I have piles of music for some of the SotM characters (either things that they would listen to or things that fit with them thematically for some reason), that I was thinking of posting as mix cd lists once I get them a bit more organized.

Some characters are harder than others. I have 3 songs on my Expatriette playlist and 4 on Absolute Zero vs a CD worth for Tachyon and Wraith.

posts.name: Adam
posts.cooked:
When I get a few moments, I’ll try and get all of it up here, ideally as expansions are released. In the meantime:

900×703 96.3 KB

These were my original designs for Voss’ Gene-Bound slaves, you can see a few things I ended up keeping and when you see the Enhanced Edition you may be surprised.
I’m partial to the guy in the lower left, who ended up going through mitosis and turning into Lt. Vyktor and the Gene-Bound Soldier.
